provisioning.raw_artifacts: Root stages <artifact_id>.tar.gz under the fixed raw inbox as root:cyberpanel 0440; no symlinks or hardlinks.
provisioning.keys: Provision a dedicated hex Ed25519 private key and target X25519 public key through the service credentials. Pin the matching manifest public key and canonical schema hash in target migration trust; never reuse core signing keys.
provisioning.request: Root invokes cyberpanel-backup-convert convert with strict JSON on stdin: version=1, request_id, artifact_id, tenant_id, target_installation_id, deadline (UTC, at most 15 minutes). Reuse request_id on an uncertain response.
provisioning.handoff: CLI output includes migration_create: operation=migration.create, tenant_id, suggested_idempotency_key and payload {source:cyberpanel_backup,source_endpoint:<bundle_endpoint>}. Submit that payload through the existing authenticated migration.create operation for the same tenant; do not submit the full converter response. See packaging/cyberpanel-backup-convert.md. Conversion never creates target resources or initiates import.
provisioning.limits: Raw compressed archive and expanded archive are each capped at 2 TiB, expansion ratio at 512, entries at 250000, captured metadata at 64 MiB aggregate/16 MiB per member. Each emitted site tree, mail tree, SQL dump or certificate chunk is at most 64 GiB; total referenced unique chunk bytes are at most 2 TiB. Deadline is at most 15 minutes. Multipart artifacts are unsupported because current shared manifest/import canonicalization sorts chunk references by digest.
provisioning.cleanup: After target cleanup evidence, stop the service and remove its binary, unit, configuration, credentials and private scratch/receipts. Do not remove admitted quarantine bundles until normal migration cleanup authorizes removal.
